runs.t: Thad and Cath go on a jog at camp.
They have six tracks to pick from.
Thump! Thump! Thud! “What was that?” asks Cath.
Thad looks and sees a big rock on the track.
“This rock fell from that hill. That was the thud,” says Thad.
“We were in luck that we did not get hit!” says Cath.
“Let’s go on the sixth track back to camp,” says Thad.
Thad and Cath jog back to camp.
At camp they grab a wet cloth.
“That was a fun jog,” says Thad.
